tools.name: findRelevantWork
tools.description: Search WeTheMakers case studies by industry, product type, or technology. Use to answer questions like "have they built anything for logistics", "show me their fintech work", or "do they use React Native". Returns matching case studies with a one-line summary and a link to each.

query.description: Industry, product type, or technology to look for. Examples: "logistics", "fintech mobile app", "React Native", "e-commerce".
